# II. THE CUP: THE GIFT, AND WHAT IT ASKS [color=#55636E]Restricted. For the patient of a full year. If you are newer than that, read it anyway, because you will, and then go back and read the first teaching again.[/color]
### #1 elder_of_the_north_roof (OP) // 83.03.30 The first one drank and came apart, and from his pieces came everything that lives. So the Cup is not poison. It is the oldest medicine there is. It takes what you are and makes it into what you were meant to be.
But hear the second half, because the young ones never do. On LV-223, the urns were broken open and the gift spilled across the floors, and what it made there was not beautiful. The gift does not ask what you want. It asks what you are. It answers honestly.
Nobody here takes the Cup. Nobody here has the Cup. When the Makers return they will offer it to us themselves, and the worthy will drink.
### #2 salvage_rat // 83.04.02 Then I have a question I need an elder to answer, and I need it answered tonight.
I work breakdown on the scrap barges. Last rotation we cracked a hull the size of a hab block, grown, not welded, and in a side chamber there was a vessel. Tall as my knee, a face carved on it, cold to the touch. I did not open it. I did not. But something inside it moves when you tip it, slow, like oil in the cold.
It is under my bunk. What do I do.
### #3 elder_of_the_north_roof (OP) // 83.04.02 You do not open it. You do not let anyone open it. You keep it cold, and you keep it still, and you wait. You have not been chosen to drink. You have been chosen to keep.
### #4 night_lab_wash // 83.04.05 I am not one of you. I clean in a place where they have a little of it in a sealed cabinet, and I want you to know what I saw.
A tech in a suit put one drop on a dish with a beetle in it. Over a shift the beetle grew. Not bigger. Wrong. More legs, then fewer, then something that was not legs, and then it was a black wet thing that kept trying to climb the glass. They burned it and the dish together.
Then one of the techs was taken off the rotation. They said he had an eye infection. His eyes had gone dark, all the way across. Something moved in them. He was very calm about it. That was the worst part. He was so calm.
It is not medicine. Whatever you think it is, it is not medicine.
### #5 pale_since_seventy_nine // 83.04.05 It answered honestly, then. The elder said so. A beetle does not know what it is meant to be.
### #6 kneeling_man // 83.04.11 I have been patient for four years. I have gone pale on every vigil night. I have sat on the roof through the cold season until I could not feel my hands. I have never seen a light that moved wrong. Not once.
What if they are not coming. What if they are waiting for us to come to them, the way the map says. What if the Cup is not a reward. What if it is the door.
### #7 elder_of_the_north_roof (OP) // 83.04.11 kneeling_man. Brother. The door is not yours to open. Come to the vigil tonight. Sit next to me. We will look up together.
### #8 salvage_rat // 83.04.19 The vessel is gone from under my bunk. I was on shift. The lock was not broken. kneeling_man and I worked the same barge last year. I told him about it, before I posted here. I am sorry. I am so sorry.
### #9 elder_of_the_north_roof (OP) // 83.04.23 We found him on the north roof at first light, where he always sat. He was facing the sky. The vessel was beside him, open, and empty.
We will not describe him. We have argued all night about whether what was sitting there was closer to them or further away. Some of the patient say they saw it smile. Others say it had no mouth left to smile with. It did not speak, which is our custom. It did not move, until the medics came, and then it did.
This thread is locked. The Cup was not taken. It was answered.
[color=#D9B56C][bold]IF YOU HAVE FOUND A VESSEL, KEEP IT COLD. KEEP IT STILL. TELL NO ONE YOU LOVE.[/bold][/color]
